name: Infinite Water Bucket
summary: This mod makes it so that you can place water source blocks infinitely as long as you have 1 water bucket.
description: # Infinite Water Bucket ![Infinite Water Bucket cover image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/infinite-water-bucket/main/.modcompiler-art/description-image.webp) Never run out of water again! This simple yet powerful mod makes water buckets infinite - they never empty when you place water. ## Features ### Infinite Water (Enabled by Default) - Water buckets never empty when placing water - Works in survival and creative mode - Perfect for building, farming, and redstone contraptions - No more tedious bucket refilling ### Optional Infinite Lava - Lava buckets never empty when placing lava - WARNING: Very overpowered - use with caution! ### Optional Infinite Milk - Milk buckets never empty when drinking - Unlimited potion effect removal ## How It Works When you use a water bucket to place water, it normally turns into an empty bucket. This mod detects the bucket use and automatically refills it after 1 tick, keeping the filled bucket in your inventory.
author: Sekai0ni0Itamio
